comparison.objective: Lower an entire cable into a trench without touching its edge; candidate fractures and retrieves tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated deformable-object support and clearance maintenance differ from rigid mandrel alignment, bimanual hammering, fracture control, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Whole cable and caps in the trench, released, with no edge contact versus four tangs fractured and tray-contained with no coil or shell damage.
comparison.reason: This tests collision-free deformable placement rather than controlled impact fracture.
